commit.message: docs(changelog): record compaction API fix and POLIS contract

specification.objective: Address Hermes catalog PR #140369 review #5557895958: stop rebinding MemoryStore._mutate during Desktop AI compaction, use the public atomic apply_batch API, preserve the Magi 1.7.8 feature and compatibility contracts, test concurrent writers, and document the correction in the 1.7.8 changelog. This contract reconstructs and validates a correction already committed locally as 9327744; it does not claim that the original implementation followed this POLIS lock chronologically.

requirements.statement: Call the public MemoryStore.apply_batch(target, operations) directly for AI compaction, without wrapping, rebinding, deleting, or depending on private MemoryStore._mutate and its skip_drift parameter.

Preserve both MEMORY.md and USER.md Desktop compaction paths: preview fingerprint precheck, input and budget validation, full matched_entry pins, single atomic batch, response shape, and all other Magi review/edit functionality.

Use Hermes native batch atomicity to preserve concurrent added entries and reject stale pinned removals without partial updates; do not claim an atomic full-snapshot precondition that the public API cannot guarantee.

Keep the plugin version 1.7.8, requires_hermes floor and all existing plugin registrations and dependencies unchanged; append the fix to CHANGELOG section 1.7.8 with the concurrency behavior and tests.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Regression exercises memory and user compaction with a store rejecting _mutate rebinding and confirms the public apply_batch succeeds.

Regression verifies fingerprint mismatch rejection, requested entries and budgets validation, pinned operations and single all-or-nothing native batch, plus existing pending and stored memory API tests.
Regression models concurrent additions and deletions with a fake store and native disk-backed Hermes; additions survive and missing pins abort without partial writes.

Complete test suite and configured POLIS coverage gate pass above 95% line coverage; Hermes plugin validation reports ok with no core override; manifest stays 1.7.8 and changelog records the change in 1.7.8.

invariants.statement: All pending-write decisions, stored-memory CRUD, optional compaction model permissions, preview and apply routes and UI remain available with the existing Hermes API contracts.
Hermes controls locking, validation and disk writes; the plugin uses only public apply_batch for the mutation and does not mutate the host's method bindings.
Release remains 1.7.8 and change paths stay restricted to dashboard/plugin_api.py, tests/test_desktop.py, CHANGELOG.md and POLIS retained evidence.

forbidden_states.statement: Compaction reassigns MemoryStore._mutate, calls it, or relies on its private skip_drift signature.
Concurrent writer data is discarded, or a failed stale pinned batch partially commits new entries.
Version bump, unrelated feature changes, history rewrite, remote push, or GitHub review reply.

inputs.statement: Magi commit 65e94bd5ddb4f9635baf9b6c996900e47748e76b, the last published 1.7.8 baseline before the local fix.
Hermes maintainer review #5557895958 on NousResearch/hermes-agent PR #140369, requesting direct public apply_batch with existing matched_entry pins.
Pre-existing local fix 93277443fff21d4b97355d833cd544b5e2d25947; historic tests are reconstructed on an isolated clean baseline for regression proof.

outputs.statement: Revised regression tests and native Hermes disk concurrency coverage in tests/test_desktop.py.
1.7.8 CHANGELOG entry and POLIS locked contract, proof and validation artifacts with a subsequent local-only commit.

failure_semantics.statement: Reject a stale preview before applying any operation and rely on Hermes batch error for a missing matched_entry without committing a partial batch.
If contract evidence, coverage or plugin validation fails, report the exact failure and do not push or respond on GitHub.
